name: Split Sheet Studio BETA — Invited contributor onboarding

parameters.content:
## BETA: Invited contributor

Only blakmarigold@gmail.com receives beta mail. Separate local database; production remains unchanged.

Welcome → first action → vault → plugin skins → approved collaborators → next session.
Timing: 0, 2, 4, 7, 10, 14 minutes. Check every minute.

Start/restart or send the next email manually at:
http://192.168.1.70:5051/admin/email-journeys

Uses the existing AWS SES sender and an embedded screenshot header. dryRun=true previews counts; set false to run beta delivery. Keep the beta app running on this computer. Production requires its own deployment and published workflows after owner approval.
